jobs_results.title: Back-end Developer
jobs_results.description:
A Little Bit About Flanks

Flanks is a Barcelona-based fintech company focused on wealth management services. Its main product is a SaaS solution that helps financial advisors, family offices and other institutions to have a holistic view of their clients’ financial assets while using the latest scraping technology. We’re currently building the benchmark in the OpenWealth industry, and so far we managed to have compatibility with over 250 national and international entities.

Thanks to our clients, we continue to grow at a fast pace. We have already more than 300,000 aggregated portfolios spread across nearly 250 entities and have positioned our business at break-even in less than a year. In August 2021, Flanks raised €2.3 million in an investment round led by JME Ventures and SeedRocket 4Founders Capital. And a significant €7.5 million in August 2023, demonstrating confidence in our vision and capabilities.

We are pioneers in our market in Spain, which will certainly grow a lot in... the next few months and years. However, we are going to take a league leap in terms of the volumetry of the system, as our key focus now is to accelerate our market expansion in Europe and LatAm. And we would like to count on you to also grow (personally and professionally) with us.

Flanks’s values are:
• People first: To us, the most important thing is for “Flankers” to feel at ease, for them to get involved in a project and be feel part of the team.
• Keep growing: Our team believes that people growing in lockstep with the company is essential, both personally and professionally.
• Think twice, act once: We like to think about all the possible consequences before taking any decision that could affect the team or our clients.

If you’re looking to grow professionally in a very fast-growing company with an exciting start-up culture, this is your opportunity!

About The Role

You will be a Backend Developer in our company. You'll be working as a full member of the Drivers team, participating in the process of data extraction from various custodian entities. You will be working with Python as a basis and custom techniques and methodologies in order to make data extraction and processing at large scale. You will cooperate with technical and financial people in order to understand in detail what you’re processing.

Responsibilities

Examples of tasks you can expect to work on are:
• Understand and automate the login process of financial institutions websites with multi factor authentication mechanisms
• Reverse engineering of online banking websites
• All of the steps of an ETL data pipeline
• Data extraction from websites content, csv and pdf documents

Our tech stack
• Python as code base
• Browser emulation tools
• Pandas for document data parsing
• Jenkins as CI/CD
• MongoDB as data storage tool

Things we'd love to see on you
• You are a nice person: Assholes and bigotry won’t be tolerated.
• You live in Barcelona City and/or close enough to work at the office twice/three times a week. Living in Spain is a mandatory requirement, and a non-negotiable requirement.
• Likewise, we can’t offer a relocation package and/or working visa.
• You have working English and Spanish proficiency.
• You have some experience in similar roles. We're looking for someone with some lessons already learned.
• Working experience with data pipelines and scrapping.
• You are familiar with MongoDB.
• Meaningful experience with Javascript will be a huge plus.
• We will be helping you to grow, so don't worry if you don't check all the boxes!

What Can We Offer

We offer what we think is fair compensation (from 23K to 30K € per year for this role). We're on top of the market, but our intention is to increase compensation as the company grows. You will not be left behind. We believe this is a really nice time to join the project. This is a full-time, permanent contract.

A non-exhaustive list of perks includes:

🏠 Office between Sants Estació and Plaça Espanya, with a 280 degree view of Barcelona.

🔆 Flexible working hours

🎊 Paid time off on your birthday

🍒 Fresh fruit every week, all-you-can-drink tea and coffee

🍻 Friday happy hours after our weekly team meetings (optional)

😎 Team building events (optional)

🙀 Personal holidays swap inside the same month

🍽️ Digital canteen with Nora in our offices subsidized at 50%.

🏥 Health insurance

💸 Flexible remuneration with Cobee

📚 Yearly training budget

The hiring process

This is how the usual hiring process looks like:
• You send us your resume, cover letter, etc.
• A chat with our CTO Sergi Lao, where we’ll dive deeper into your background, your possible fit, and where you’ll have the opportunity to ask any sort of questions.
• We will send you a technical test so we can see how you deal with problems and how you manage Python.
• A meeting with our CTO and our CEO Joaquim de la Cruz.
• Optionally, any other meeting you or us might need to clarify any pending questions.
• We send you an offer.

We expect a few days to pass between each step. We aim for a process as short as one week and never longer than one month.

If you think you meet most of the criteria described above, don’t hesitate to send us your CV and/or cover letter. We will be happy to hear from you!

Flanks is deeply committed to diversity, equity and inclusion both in our hiring practices and in our experiences as a Flanks employee. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and encourage all applicants regardless of race, religion, or belief (if any), nationality, ethnic or national origin, gender, gender identity, pregnancy and maternity, sexual orientation, age, marital and civil partnership status, or disability status

jobs_results.title: Desarrollador de back-end | Experto en Wordpress
jobs_results.description:
En DominioZero estamos buscando un perfil de desarrollo backend y experto en Wordpress para incorporación inmediata a nuestro equipo de desarrollo web.

Qué buscamos en ti:
• 💻 Conocimiento profundo y avanzado de BBDD.
• 🤓 Experto en WordPress (se valora positivamente conocimiento y experiencia en otros CMS como PrestaShop y Magento).
• 🕸️ Experiencia en la gestión de hosting, haciendo lanzamientos y migraciones de páginas web
• 🔧 Experiencia realizando mantenimientos para webs, dando soporte y atención al cliente.
• 👨💻 Experiencia en programación de plugins y funcionalidades a medida para páginas web en Wordpress
• 💙 Conocimiento del paquete de Atlassian (Jira Software).
• ⏩ Capacidad para resolver incidencias e imprevistos.
• 📚 Capacidad y actitud de formación continua, carácter curioso y autodidacta.
• 🤝 Experiencia en trabajo en equipo y coordinación de diferentes proyectos de forma simultanea.

Vale, ¿Y quienes sois?

Somos una agencia pequeña, familiar, muy cañera y... disfrutona.

Nos encantan los retos, somos muy autoexigentes e intentamos que cada proyecto nuevo supere las expectativas de nuestros clientes.

Siempre estamos buscando superar nuestros propios limites, nos encanta estar a la ultima y hacer que nuestros clientes se enamoren de nuestro trabajo.

Con esto quiero decir que como desarrollador, no te vas a aburrir ni un minuto.

Lo que te ofrecemos
• 💸 Salario competitivo negociable en función de experiencia.
• 🔝 Capacidad de crecer y desarrollar tu perfil, demostrar tu valía y aplicar a puestos de liderazgo.
• 🤘 Ambiente de trabajo agradable y distendido: Está mal que lo digamos nosotros, pero te rodearás de gente que siempre estará dispuesta a echarte una mano
• 🏠 Teletrabajo ocasional: Si lo necesitas, podrás teletrabajar desde casa de forma ocasional, siempre que nos avises con antelación.
• 🙏 Confianza y cercanía: No somos una big tech ni creemos en estructuras verticales de organización, si necesitas algún día libre o cambiar el horario algún día, sólo es cuestión de hablarlo.
• 👨🎓 Formación constante: Creemos que la formación es fundamental, por eso si quieres continuar formándote contaras con nuestro apoyo.
• ⏳ Horario flexible: El horario habitual suele ser de 09:00 a 17:00, el viernes tarde libre, pero si lo necesitas, tendrás la posibilidad de modificar el horario

jobs_results.title: Desarrollador de back-end
jobs_results.description:
¡En Top Doctors Group seguimos creciendo!

¿Te gustaría unirte a una empresa que ha revolucionado el sector médico privado y que pronto será líder mundial en el sector de la salud?

Top Doctors Group somos una empresa líder en salud y tecnología con presencia internacional. Estamos buscando una persona para incorporar al equipo de Tecnología como Desarrollador Backend para unirse a nuestro equipo para el mantenimiento de los aplicativos.

Como Desarrollador Backend, desempeñarás un papel fundamental en la solución y previsión de errores. La persona candidata ideal es competente en PHP, NodeJs y MySQL.

Es importante el conocimiento del mundo del ecommerce especialmente Wordpress/ Woocommerce y Bigcommerce. Además, ha trabajado o conoce React, MongoDB. Buscamos una persona proactiva y apasionada que prospere en un entorno dinámico, sin miedo a afrontar nuevos retos y problemas.

🖥️ ¿Cuál será tu rol?
• Implementar y mantener APIs RESTful para permitir la integración fluida entre... sistemas frontend y backend. Garantizar la calidad del código escribiendo código limpio, eficiente y bien documentado, así como realizando revisiones de código e implementando las mejores prácticas.
• Reportar el progreso y los posibles obstáculos al líder del proyecto o al equipo de gestión.
• Identificar y solucionar problemas técnicos, errores y vulnerabilidades de seguridad, así como optimizar el rendimiento de las aplicaciones.
• Cumplir con los plazos de entrega y objetivos del proyecto.
• Crear documentación técnica, como comentarios en el código, documentación de API y manuales de usuario si es necesario.

📌 Requisitos mínimos:
• Experiencia +3 años en PHP.
• Conocimiento de NodeJs.
• Se valorará conocimiento de React.
• Experiencia en la creación y consumo de API RESTful.
• Familiaridad con bases de datos relacionales (como MySQL) y no relacionales (como MongoDB).
• Conocimiento del mundo del ecommerce especialmente Wordpress/ Woocommerce y Bigcommerce.
• Sólido entendimiento de metodologías de desarrollo de software, (Agile y Scrum).
• Habilidades de comunicación efectivas para colaborar con otros miembros del equipo.

🙂 ¿Qué Ofrecemos?:
• ♾️Estabilidad y crecimiento.
• 💻Modalidad de trabajo remota.
• 👥Líderes qué priorizan el acompañamiento en el día a día.
• 🎂 Tendrás libre el día de tu cumpleaños.
• 💱Beneficios sociales y retribución flexible a tu medida.
• 🌎Ambiente de trabajo joven e internacional.
• 🥳 Sabemos divertirnos, mucha diversión.

En TOP DOCTORS GROUP, nos enorgullece crear un entorno de trabajo inclusivo donde se valora y respeta la diversidad de todas las personas. Creemos que, al reconocer y atender las diferencias individuales, todos los empleados pueden desarrollar plenamente sus talentos y contribuir al éxito de nuestra empresa. Tenemos un compromiso en adaptarnos a tus necesidades personales, por lo que te animamos a que nos contactes si requieres cualquier tipo de ajuste para poder desplegar tu talento y apoyarte en las dificultades que te pueda generar tus peculiaridades

jobs_results.description:
¡Apiux está buscando un/a 💛DESARROLLADOR BACKEND JAVA SPRINGBOOT💛 para Teletrabajar en España!

Somos una empresa tecnológica especializada en apoyar a organizaciones de todas las industrias en su proceso de Transformación Digital. Estamos presentes en Chile, Perú, Colombia, EE. UU, España y seguimos en constante expansión.

Cliente: Líder en el sector

Experiencia: 3 años

Contrato: Indefinido

Modalidad 💛💛Teletrabajo 100% 💛💛

Perfil: 💛Desarrollador Backend con al menos 3 años de experiencia

Conocimiento Clave: SPRINGBOOT

Horario: Oficina (Disponibilidad para realizar guardias)

Disponibilidad para viajar: No

Salario: 30.000 a 37.000€

Requisitos Obligatorios:
• Ingles alto como para mantener conversaciones fluidas en el idioma.
• Experiencia demostrable en el desarrollo de aplicaciones backend de al menos 3 años, preferiblemente en múltiples proyectos o en proyectos de gran escala, mostrando una progresión en la complejidad de las tareas realizadas y las responsabilidades... asumidas.

Conocimientos técnicos:
• Java: Dominio completo del lenguaje de programación Java, incluidas sus últimas características y mejores prácticas.
• Spring Framework y Spring Boot: Experiencia en el uso de Spring Boot para crear aplicaciones web y de microservicios escalables. Esto incluye trabajar con Spring Data JPA, Spring Security, entre otros.
• Bases de Datos: Conocimiento en el manejo de bases de datos relacionales (como MySQL, PostgreSQL) y no relacionales (como MongoDB).
• APIs: Experiencia en diseño e implementación de APIs RESTful y comprensión de protocolos de comunicación como HTTP/HTTPS.
• Seguridad: Conocimiento en la implementación de medidas de seguridad y autenticación, utilizando herramientas como JWT (JSON Web Tokens) o OAuth2.
• Pruebas: Capacidad para escribir y mantener pruebas unitarias y de integración, preferiblemente con herramientas como JUnit y Mockito.
• Herramientas de Desarrollo: Uso de herramientas de construcción y gestión de dependencias como Maven o Gradle y control de versiones con Git.
• DevOps: Conocimientos básicos de prácticas DevOps, incluyendo CI/CD con Jenkins, Docker para la contenerización, y Kubernetes para la orquestación de contenedores. Habilidades Complementarias
• Patrones de Diseño: Entendimiento de patrones de diseño de software y principios SOLID para escribir código limpio y mantenible.
• Microservicios: Experiencia en el diseño y desarrollo de arquitecturas basadas en microservicios.
• Comunicación y Trabajo en Equipo: Capacidad para colaborar eficazmente con otros miembros del equipo, incluidos desarrolladores frontend, diseñadores y gestores de proyectos.
• Resolución de Problemas: Habilidad para identificar problemas de manera eficiente y proponer soluciones efectivas.

Beneficios:
• Contrato indefinido
• Teletrabajo 100%
• Rango salarial competitivo en función a la experiencia
• 23 días de vacaciones
• 4 días de vacaciones adiciones al año por permanencia en la empresa.
• Apiux Academy: Formación, entrenamientos técnicos e interacción con la comunidad tech para desarrollar tu talento al máximo.
• Clases de inglés y profesor de inglés 24/7.
• Día de tu cumpleaños libre.
• Bonos por nacimiento, matrimonio y referidos.
• Happy Points: Un sistema de puntos que puedes canjear por días libres.
• Proyectos de larga duración y en algunos casos internacionales.
• Y-Share: ¡Sé dueño de una parte de la compañía uniéndose a nuestro programa!

Apiux Tecnología 💛💛es una empresa que acelera y permite el crecimiento con tecnología, innovación y desarrollo del talento. Con ello, apoyamos a las organizaciones en su proceso de transformación digital, modernización e implementaciones.

¡Aplica ahora y prepárate para liderar el cambio!💛💛

• Resolución de Problemas: Habilidad para identificar problemas de manera eficiente y proponer soluciones efectivas.

jobs_results.title: Backend Developer - Golang
jobs_results.description:
Software Engineer - Backend Developer - Golang
@ BlueThrone This role is not just a job; it's a calling for those who dare to lead, inspire, and transform the digital landscape. Join us, and let's chart the course to a future written in the stars of success.
• Remote, work from anywhere *

About BlueThrone

Embark on a transformative journey with BlueThrone, a pioneer in the mobile app domain. We specialize in turning promising B2C mobile apps into market leaders, boasting over 49.5 million organic downloads and 4.6 million monthly active users. With a mission to propel iOS and Android applications to new heights, we've achieved a remarkable ARR organically in just 25 months, exemplifying sustainable growth and innovation. Our team, rich in tech entrepreneurship and mobile marketing expertise, thrives in an environment that values agility, a growth mindset, flexibility, creativity, and tangible outcomes. At BlueThrone, your career is more than a job—it's a journey towards excellence... in an innovative culture where high performance is as valued as innovation.
The Opportunity

Join us at BlueThrone as a Senior Backend Developer / Software Engineer, where your expertise plays a crucial role in evolving our legacy systems and pioneering new technologies. This is a unique opportunity to apply your skills in Golang and cloud services in real-world applications, directly impacting our strategic direction. You'll lead the charge in building resilient, scalable systems from the ground up, transforming our technological landscape. Here, your work is not just about writing code—it's about laying the foundation for future innovations and driving the success of a company at the forefront of the digital domain. Dive into a role where your passion for technology and innovation shapes the future of our company and the industry at large.

Your Mission

∙Strategic System Architecture: Design and implement robust backend architectures that support scalable and resilient systems, ensuring they align with our strategic objectives and can evolve with industry trends.

∙ Legacy System Enhancement: Proactively identify opportunities for optimizing and refactoring legacy codebases, improving performance, and reducing technical debt without compromising system stability.

∙ Innovative System Development: Lead the charge in developing a new, state-of-the-art system from scratch, employing advanced programming techniques and technologies to set new industry benchmarks.

∙ Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with cross-disciplinary teams to align the backend technology with overall business goals, ensuring our core platform supports and drives strategic objectives.

Your Expedition Toolkit

∙ Expertise: Profound command over Golang with a 5+ years of hands-on experience in developing high-performance, production-level apps.

∙Database Mastery: Extensive experience with PostgreSQL, with the ability to design complex schemas, optimize queries for performance, and implement best practices for database security and integrity.

∙Cloud Engineering: Deep knowledge of Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services, with expertise in architecting and managing scalable, secure, and resilient cloud-native applications.

∙ DevOps and Infrastructure: Comprehensive understanding of DevOps principles, practices, and tools, including CI/CD, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation).

∙Exceptional Communicator: Ability to articulate technical visions and challenges to stakeholders at all levels, facilitating clear and effective collaboration in a supportive environment.

∙ Energetic and Positive Leadership: Inspire your team with a can-do attitude, encouraging innovation, risk-taking, and collective problem-solving.

∙ Strategic Thinker: You not only excel in technical execution but also contribute to strategic discussions, helping shape the future direction of our tech & products.

∙ You are a strong communicator, with a professional Proficiency in English. Knowladge of Russian or/and Hebrew is advantage.

Why Join BlueThrone?

Join us in a role that's more than a job - it's a chance to be part of a transformative mission, propelling mobile apps to unparalleled success. We offer not just a career but a lifestyle, blending professional growth with personal well-being.

🚀 Innovative Culture: Be part of a company that's redefining the mobile app market, backed by a business model that blends professional growth with personal well-being.

🏝 Work from Anywhere: Enjoy the freedom to work from anywhere, with flexible hours that suit your lifestyle.

💻 Impactful Work: Your role directly contributes to the company's growth and success in the fast-paced world of mobile app acquisitions.

🏆 Collaborative Environment: Join a team of talented professionals in a supportive atmosphere that fosters creativity and innovation.

🃏 Career Development: At BlueThrone, personal and professional growth isn't just a possibility – it's a priority.

🌍 Global Reach: Work with a diverse team of 50 exceptional talents spread across over 19 countries, expanding your professional network and cultural understanding.

Ready to embark on a journey with BlueThrone? Apply Now

jobs_results.title: Back End Developer
jobs_results.description:
Who is DEKRA? Since its foundation in 1925, the DEKRA promise has been to ensure the safety of human interaction with technology and the environment. The company currently employs around 52,000 people in more than 60 countries on all five continents. With qualified and independent expert services, they provide safety on the road, at work and at home.

We have a clear and ambitious vision of the future. The vision for our 100th birthday in 2025 is to see DEKRA as the global partner for a safe world.

On this ocassion, an exciting opportunity has arisen in our DIGITAL & PRODUCT SOLUTIONS Division. This area is to focus on tech competencies and drive digital innovation to help leading DEKRA into a successful future.

You want to know more? Here we go!

Role position:

We are currently looking for a Backend Developer to strengthen our Big Data Team.

About Big Data Team:

DEKRA offers value to companies through technology, with solid, innovative, flexible and efficient IT products and... services, focused on the digitization needs of companies, providing improvements in their business and decision-making processes. The Big Data & Analytics solutions are based on specialized methodologies and software tools that enable the collection, analysis, and selection of large amounts of data, transforming it into useful information for management processes, decision making, new service development, and business opportunity identification.

Requirements:
• Experience with REST APIs and WebServices.
• Solid hands on working with Spring Framework (Security, MVC, SpringData, Spring Boot and Spring Cloud).
• Experience with Microservices.
• Comfortable using SQL (experience with NoSQL databases is a plus).

Additional Requirements:
• GIT and Maven experience.
• Knowledge of JIRA.

Desirable:
• Knowledge of containers (Docker, Kubernetes…).
• Messaging with Kafka/RabbitMQ.

Profile:
• Bachelor Degree in Computer Science or similar.
• Deep Knowledge in Object Oriented Programming and developing with Java applications.
• Written and spoken English and Spanish.
• Customer-focused attitude.

Benefits include:
• Flexible and dynamic working environment.
• Hybrid role position: Possibility to 3 remote days each week after trial period. Besides, flexible arrival and lunch time.
• Opportunities for continuous learning and upskilling.
• Flexible retribution with possibility of private health insurance, restaurant and kindergarten vouchers.
• Permanent contract in a multinational with a long history.
• Joining a multicultural team where you will feel like a member from day one.
• Help you drive towards your goals.

What is the location of the position?
• Málaga, Madrid or Barcelona (hybrid mode).

Let's consider that we have an interesting project and we want you to be part of it. Don't hesitate, join our team

jobs_results.description:
About Fundcraft

fundcraft is a fast-growing, tech-powered fund services provider, aiming to revolutionise the fund management industry through our proprietary platform. Our dedicated team of financial experts, lawyers, tech developers, and data scientists are fully committed to turning the organisation to a leading fund services firm, in Europe and beyond. The company was founded in 2020 and has been experiencing rapid growth, already employing more than 75 professionals in two countries.

About The Role

Key responsibilities:
• You will collaborate with a cross-functional scrum team that develops in Python, ReactJS, Docker and AWS Cloud technologies
• You will design, build and maintain API’s, services and systems across fundcraft’s engineering teams
• You will collaborate in improving engineering standards, tooling and processes

How you will be successful in your application

Must-Have Experience / Qualifications
• You have at least 1 year of experience working as a Backend... Engineer
• Experience in the development, deployment, and maintenance of web-based technology applications with Python or the ability and interest in working with it
• Devotion to clean and well-done code
• Spanish: fluent level (spoken and written)
• English: fluent level (spoken and written)

Preferred Qualifications
• Experience with other elements of fundcraft's tech stack: Django, Celery, OpenAPI, Javascript, React, PostgreSQL, AWS
• Experience working with Agile methodologies

What you will get in return

A culture where you can thrive..
• An entrepreneurial culture encouraging creativity and innovative, disruptive ideas,
• A diverse and fast-paced work environment and the ability to interact with/learn from a wide variety of specialists,
• A multicultural team promoting our corporate values of Ownership, Transparency, Team spirit, Boldness,
• Workplace automation and application of new technologies across workflows.

Benefits To Support You In Your Journey..
• Internal training and career development opportunities,
• Stock options offerings - our success is your success,
• Flexible working hours, home working options, attractive package after 1 year,
• Ergonomic work equipment and spacious, modern offices located in Girona(We are 5 min walk from the train station)

Selection process
• Stage 1: Video interview with our HR department (45 min)
• Stage 2: Meet the Team: interview with the hiring manager and a senior member of the team (45 min)
• Stage 3: Interview with a member of the management team or another member of the team (Optional) (45 min
